root.label: Iterator adaptors and sentinels
root.note: Wrappers that redefine moving or reading, and ends that need not be iterators.

children.label: reverse_iterator
children.note: Swaps increment and decrement; needs a bidirectional iterator.

children.label: Off-by-one base
children.note: base() points one past the element: *r is *std::prev(r.base()).

children.label: Erasing
children.note: Erase through r with v.erase(std::next(r).base()), or the neighbour goes.

children.label: From an iterator
children.note: reverse_iterator(it) denotes the element before it.

children.label: Moving and inserting
children.note: Adaptors that change what dereference or assignment does.

children.label: move_iterator
children.note: Dereferences to an rvalue via iter_move; algorithms that read twice see moved-from values.

children.label: move_sentinel
children.note: C++20 wrapper letting a move_iterator compare with a sentinel.

children.label: Insert iterators
children.note: Assignment calls push_back, push_front or insert; front_inserter reverses order.

children.label: Stream iterators
children.note: istream_iterator reads in its constructor; ostream_iterator writes a trailing delimiter.

children.label: Sentinels
children.note: A type that only answers whether iteration is done.

children.label: sentinel_for
children.note: Semiregular and ==-comparable with the iterator; one operator== suffices in C++20.

children.label: iterator_t, sentinel_t
children.note: Types of ranges::begin and ranges::end; common_range means they are the same.

children.label: unreachable_sentinel
children.note: Never equal to any iterator; drops bounds checks, UB if the value is absent.

children.label: subrange
children.note: Iterator plus sentinel as a borrowed view, with structured bindings.

children.label: counted_iterator
children.note: An iterator with a countdown, done when the count reaches zero.

children.label: default_sentinel
children.note: Compares equal to a counted_iterator whose count is zero.

children.label: views::counted
children.note: span if contiguous, subrange(it, it + n) if random access, else counted_iterator.

children.label: Trusts the count
children.note: Fewer than n elements after it means undefined behavior.

children.label: common_iterator
children.note: Holds an iterator or a sentinel so both ends share one type.

children.label: views::common
children.note: Makes any range common for pre-C++20 iterator-pair APIs; needs a copyable iterator.

children.label: C++23 alternative
children.note: ranges::to and from_range constructors accept any range directly.

children.label: Const iterators
children.note: C++23 (P2278) made ranges::cbegin genuinely const.

children.label: basic_const_iterator
children.note: Adaptor whose dereference yields the const reference type.

children.label: ranges::cbegin fix
children.note: On a span it now yields const int&; in C++20 it was writable.

children.label: std::cbegin unchanged
children.note: Non-member std::cbegin on a span still returns a mutable iterator.
